property_summary: When the pool contract receives an ERC721 safeTransferFrom to itself, the buggy onERC721Received returns 0x70a08231 instead of 0x150b7a02, causing the safe transfer to revert on the mutant but succeed on the reference.
change_summary: Replace the return value with the selector of a different function, e.g. ERC721.onERC721Received.selector (0x150b7a02) replaced by ERC721.balanceOf.selector (0x70a08231)
